title: COMPARISON OF VARIOUS TECHNIQUES FOR MANAGEMENT OF FISTULA-IN-ANO
author: Dr. Yogeshkumar N. Modiya
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Preparation of the patient
steps.instruction: The patient is placed in a lithotomy position. The buttocks are cleaned with povidone-iodine solution.

steps.title: Endoanal ultrasound
steps.instruction: Endoanal ultrasound is performed to assess the fistula tract. The probe is inserted into the anal canal, and the ultrasound images are obtained.

steps.title: Methenamine silver staining
steps.instruction: A biopsy sample is taken from the fistula tract and stained with methenamine silver to identify the type of fistula.

steps.title: Fistulotomy
steps.instruction: A fistulotomy is performed to open the fistula tract. The tract is dissected, and the abscess is drained.

steps.title: Seton placement
steps.instruction: A seton is placed in the fistula tract to keep it open and promote healing. The seton is made of a non-absorbable material.

steps.title: Fistulectomy
steps.instruction: A fistulectomy is performed to remove the fistula tract. The tract is excised, and the surrounding tissue is closed.

steps.title: Ligation of the intersphincteric fistula tract
steps.instruction: The intersphincteric fistula tract is ligated to prevent recurrence. The tract is closed with sutures.

steps.title: Postoperative care
steps.instruction: The patient is monitored for postoperative complications. The wound is dressed, and the patient is given antibiotics.
